1. **Mixed commercial contexts without a clear boundary**: The transcript portion is clearly about a real-money fantasy sports gambling product (“Underdog,” “win real money,” deposit bonus). In the same segment, the content also contains a merchandise store page with numerous apparel/merch items and unrelated video description text. Because these appear in one combined segment, it is ambiguous which “commercial type” (fantasy sports platform vs. merch/e-commerce) the classification is intended to represent.

2. **Ambiguity about the target to classify**: The segment contains at least three different items of content—(a) an Underdog ad, (b) a separate video description, and (c) an unrelated merch catalog page with multiple products. Without a clear statement that the goal is to classify the entire bundle, or which specific sub-part is the classification target, any classification would be guesswork.

The transcript provides another category signal (fantasy sports betting).
